description: Long-lived, on a fleet node (launchd com.contextstack.node-listen, KeepAlive): node protocol 2 beside the work. Holds one GET work open (jobs through the job-pull path, control messages recorded before they are acted on: cancel, schedule_change), reports status, live run events and schedules, and fires the node's own schedules. tick still runs the jobs. Not a model tool.
